summary: This bill establishes a new tax credit for purchasing high fuel-efficiency vehicles and imposes a fee on the sale of low fuel-efficiency vehicles, while also updating how the fuel economy of dual-fueled automobiles is measured and displayed.

scores.thoughts: The bill introduces a new refundable tax credit for high energy performance vehicles, which would result in increased government outlays as these credits are paid out to taxpayers or transferred to dealers. This directly increases government spending.

The bill creates a new tax credit for high energy performance vehicles, effectively reducing the tax burden for those who purchase such vehicles. Conversely, it imposes a new fee (tax) on low energy performance vehicles, increasing the tax burden for manufacturers of those vehicles. The net effect on overall taxation is mixed, but the introduction of both a credit and a fee makes taxation a central theme.
